configuration.selection: Sterling: 'Okay, let's proceed with the fixed model.' Interpreted as report22 F00_fixed with ordinary filing timing.
configuration.update_policy: Retain the exact pre-2013 coefficients and preprocessing. Refresh inputs and forecasts monthly; no full-development refit, annual replacement or averaging.
configuration.preprocessing: Training median with missing indicators, training standardization; no clipping of rank inputs; training targets clipped at training1st/99th percentiles only.
configuration.financial_policy: Valid quarterly filing+1 calendar day; no extra delay; fiscal age over550 days makes ratios missing. No future backfill.
configuration.entry_policy: Monthly top20, next-session close; use prior-close cash/exposures. Maturity proceeds await next monthly entry.
configuration.holding_policy: Each lot90 calendar days; first market session on/after maturity. Open lots valued at endpoint.
configuration.cap_scope: 5% recorded-symbol and20% supplied-sector limits at entry; market drift allowed. Static sectors and incomplete issuer mapping remain limitations.
configuration.benchmark: Supplied ^SP500TR; $1m from first evaluation close to the same endpoint.
configuration.evaluated_in_this_preparation: 2013–2015 saved-forecast reproduction only; no post-2015 prediction or backtest.
configuration.evaluation_accounting: Reuse previously documented price/event accounting without overwriting archives; any newly encountered data gap must be investigated, never given an invented exit.
configuration.historical_context: Earlier different models were evaluated over the final period; preserve that history. This selected model has not received a new final-period account in this preparation.
